Bill.BriefDescription: Adjusting license fees for small trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a small trailer license fee; adding a newsection to chapter 46.16 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In lieu of the license tab fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, privateuse one or two wheeled trailers of two thousand pounds scale weight orless may be licensed upon the payment of a license fee in the sum offour dollars and fifty cents or, if the trailer was previously licensedin this state and has not been registered in another jurisdiction inthe intervening period, a renewal license fee in the sum of threedollars and twentyfive cents, but only if the trailer is operated uponpublic highways. The license fee must be collected annually for eachregistration year or fraction of a registration year. This reducedlicense fee applies only to trailers operated for personal use of theowners, and not trailers held for rental to the public or used in anycommercial or business endeavor. The fee from this section must bedeposited in the state patrol highway account.
This act is effective with registration feesthat are due or will become due October 1, 2005, and thereafter.
